name: modify_harness
description: Modify an existing harness's pipeline config. Can add/remove/update nodes, edges, slots, prompts, or overwrite the entire pipeline. Returns the updated config.

harness_name.description: Name of the harness to modify (directory name under harness/)

target.description: Target of modification. For node actions: node_id. For set_field: field path like 'description' or 'pipeline.max_steps' or 'slots.agent.description'. For replace_pipeline: ignored.

value.description: JSON string of the new value. For update_node: node object. For add_node: {id, node_object}. For remove_node: ignored. For update_edge: {source_node, edge_index, new_edge}. For set_field: the new value. For replace_pipeline: entire pipeline object.
